solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Delicious liquid in surprisingly hot mug taken round

indicators.note: the scrambled letters are wrapped round the liquid, so taken round signals one piece going inside another
the letters of in, hot and mug turn up in a surprising new order, so this signals an anagram

parts.note: water is the standard liquid

explanation.surface: Someone describes a tasty drink served in a hot mug that is handed round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word but is part of the anagram fodder alongside 'hot mug'.
explanation.definitionFit: Food that makes the mouth water is appetising, so the compound adjective is an idiom for tasty.

clue.text: Push to the edge girl troubled with amnesia

indicators.note: the letters of girl and amnesia are disturbed and thrown into disorder, so troubled signals an anagram

explanation.surface: A girl suffering from memory loss is being sidelined.
explanation.definitionFit: To sideline someone is to push them to the margins of a group, a near-literal synonym.

clue.text: Tashkent native and Zulu to remain in Great Britain?

indicators.note: the letters for Zulu and to remain sit inside the country's abbreviation, so in signals insertion

parts.note: UK, the United Kingdom, loosely stands for Great Britain; the question mark admits the stretch
Z is Zulu in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to be is to exist or remain

explanation.surface: A man from Tashkent and a Zulu are both hoping to stay on in Britain.
explanation.walkthrough: Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone born in Tashkent is a citizen of Uzbekistan, and the demonym for its people is this word.

clue.text: Notice wife plunging into warmer stream

indicators.note: the notice and wife dive inside the word for a warmer, so this signals insertion

parts.note: a heater warms a room
an ad, advertisement, is a notice

explanation.surface: A notice tells of a wife jumping into a stream warmer than expected.
explanation.definitionFit: A headwater is a tributary stream near the source of a river, so stream is a fair hypernym.

clue.text: Assistant wants line put into a flirtatious note

indicators.note: the letter for line is placed inside the word for flirtatious, so this signals insertion

parts.note: coy can mean coquettishly shy, playing hard to get
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: An assistant wants a line added to a flirty note.
explanation.definitionFit: An acolyte is an attendant or helper, originally one serving a priest at the altar.

clue.text: Italian monk leaving mountain makes proclamation

indicators.note: the mountain departs from the monk's name, so leaving signals removing those letters

parts.note: St Benedict of Nursia, founder of the Benedictines, was Italian
ben is a Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis

explanation.surface: An Italian monk comes down from a mountain to make an announcement.
explanation.definitionFit: An edict is an official decree issued by an authority, a formal proclamation.

clue.text: Lover soon having despicable person round

parts.note: in a mo, short for in a moment, means soon
a rat is a contemptible, treacherous person
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A lover is soon to be with a scoundrel around.
explanation.definitionFit: An inamorato is a male sweetheart, an Italian borrowing for a beloved man.

clue.text: Set on being taken over

indicators.note: in a down clue, taking a word over turns it upside down so it reads upwards, signalling reversal

parts.note: in cricket the on side is also called the leg side

explanation.surface: A short phrase about something set on being taken over, like a company.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, the on side and leg side are the same half of the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Jelly or glue sets as it becomes firm, which is what it does when it gels.

clue.text: Meat sandwich sent back — not on for nosh?

indicators.note: the word for on is excluded, so not signals removing those letters
the sandwich is returned, so its word is read backwards

parts.note: a burger is a meat patty in a bun
re means on or about, as in a memo heading

explanation.surface: A meat sandwich is returned as unacceptable food.
explanation.walkthrough: Reading BURGER backwards gives REGRUB; 'not on' drops RE.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal British slang words for food.

clue.text: Loathsome sailor almost exhausted entertaining love bird

indicators.note: the outer letters play host to love and bird, so entertaining signals one piece inside another

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

indicators.note: the word is not quite complete, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: bled, as in bled dry, means drained or exhausted
O is love, a zero score in tennis
the mina, also spelt myna, is an Asian starling

explanation.surface: A worn-out sailor plays host to a lovebird he finds hateful.
explanation.walkthrough: To be bled dry or bled white is to be drained of resources, hence exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abominable is detestable, a synonym for loathsome.

clue.text: Brilliant band showing class in Sinatra number

indicators.note: the word for class goes inside the song title, so in signals insertion

parts.note: My Way is Frank Sinatra's signature song
ilk means kind or class

explanation.surface: A great band displays real class in a Sinatra song.
explanation.definitionFit: Our galaxy appears as a bright, glowing strip of stars across the night sky.

clue.text: Judge soldiers retreating, bronze-clad, as enemy within

indicators.note: the bronze covers the soldiers like clothing, so clad signals one piece wrapped round another

parts.note: tan is a bronzed skin colour

indicators.note: the soldiers move backwards, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A judge sees soldiers in bronze armour fall back, like an enemy inside.
explanation.definitionFit: From the wooden horse at Troy, the term names a hidden infiltrator or malicious program.

clue.text: Ice as encountered by elite regiment in entering gorge

parts.note: the SAS, Special Air Service, is the British army's elite regiment

indicators.note: the word in goes inside the word for gorge, so entering signals insertion

parts.note: to sate yourself is to gorge to the full

explanation.surface: A gorge with ice is reached by an elite regiment.
explanation.walkthrough: Ice is slang for kill. 'gorge' looks like a ravine but is the verb, SATE.
explanation.definitionFit: In criminal slang, to ice someone means to murder them, so the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Reassembled fleet with haste set out at night

indicators.note: the letters of fleet and haste are put together again in a new order, an anagram

explanation.surface: A fleet is quickly put back together and sails out at night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set out' reads as 'departed', but it is a set of teeth taken out at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Dentures form a set that many wearers remove and soak overnight.

clue.text: Close to Meteora, crowd entering in ecstasy for religious ceremony

indicators.note: the letters go inside the word for ecstatic, so entering signals insertion

parts.note: sent means rapturously transported, as by music

indicators.note: the close of a word is its end, so this picks the final letter

parts.note: to cram is to crowd or pack in

explanation.surface: Near the Meteora monasteries, a crowd joins an ecstatic religious rite.
explanation.walkthrough: Meteora is a group of Greek monasteries on rock pillars.
explanation.definitionFit: A sacrament is a Christian rite such as baptism or the Eucharist.

clue.text: Bush ranger skinned and eaten by Lernaean monster

indicators.note: the inner letters are swallowed into the monster, so this signals insertion

parts.note: the Hydra of Lerna was the many-headed serpent killed by Hercules

indicators.note: removing the skin takes off the outer letters, leaving the middle

explanation.surface: A bush ranger is flayed and devoured by the Hydra.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bush ranger' reads as one phrase, an outlaw; split it, and Bush is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The hydrangea is a flowering shrub with large round heads of blooms.

clue.text: Saint with primate seen around church area

indicators.note: the primate is seen surrounding the saint, so this signals one piece inside another

parts.note: an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: A saint and a monkey are spotted around a church.
explanation.definitionFit: The apse is the vaulted recess at the east end of a church, behind the altar.

clue.text: Metal having variable edge — not hard

parts.note: x, y and z are algebra's variables

indicators.note: the letter for hard is excluded, so not signals removal

parts.note: to inch is to edge forward slowly
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A metal blade whose edge varies is not hard.
explanation.definitionFit: Zinc is a bluish-white metallic element used for galvanising.

clue.text: Smoothly sonorous dance music in location with turntable

parts.note: a round voice or tone is full and mellow
house is a genre of electronic dance music

explanation.surface: Mellow dance music is played in a place with a DJ's turntable.
explanation.walkthrough: The turntable looks like a record deck; it is the railway kind that turns engines.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway roundhouse is a circular engine shed built around a rotating platform for locomotives.

clue.text: Intrude clumsily being inexperienced

indicators.note: the letters of intrude are handled awkwardly into a new order, an anagram

explanation.surface: Someone who barges in clumsily is a novice.
explanation.definitionFit: An untried person has not yet been tested or proven, so lacks experience.

clue.text: Theatre character in shape

definitions.note: a noun for condition, as in good shape

parts.note: rep is repertory theatre
an air is a manner or character, as in an air of mystery

explanation.surface: A stage role in good form.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in good shape' and 'in good repair' mean the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Both nouns describe physical condition: something in good repair is in good condition.

clue.text: Bring up boys initially wanting fish

indicators.note: the letter is lacking from the word, so wanting signals removal

parts.note: to broach a subject is to raise it

indicators.note: the first letter of boys is taken

explanation.surface: Raising boys who first want to go fishing.
explanation.definitionFit: The roach is a freshwater fish of the carp family common in European rivers.

clue.text: One missed in rolling stock, hole for rivet

indicators.note: the letter for one goes missing from the word, so this signals removal

parts.note: trains are the rolling stock of a railway
I is the Roman numeral one
a fix is a predicament, as is a hole

explanation.surface: A rivet hole is overlooked in railway carriages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rivet' looks like the metal pin; it is the verb, to hold someone spellbound.
explanation.definitionFit: To rivet and to transfix both mean to hold someone motionless with fascination or horror.

clue.text: Away from wind in street in unpleasant weather

indicators.note: the sheltered side goes inside the street abbreviation, so in signals insertion

parts.note: the lee is the side sheltered from the wind

explanation.surface: Sheltering from the wind in a street during foul weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleet is a cold mix of rain and snow, a miserable kind of precipitation.

clue.text: Preserving reputation — which wastrel never can do?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: avoiding humiliation or keeping one's dignity
second meaning, read as two words: a spendthrift can never face putting money aside

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into its two words and it describes someone unable to bring themselves to save money.
explanation.definitionFit: A face-saving gesture protects someone's standing and spares them embarrassment.

clue.text: Poisonous type without delay to drop second article

indicators.note: the article is let go from the abbreviation, so to drop signals removal

parts.note: ASAP is as soon as possible
the second A, the indefinite article, is the one removed

explanation.surface: A venomous person must quickly drop the second item.
explanation.definitionFit: The asp is a venomous snake, famously Cleopatra's; type stands for a kind of creature.

clue.text: Value reflected in welcoming a wronged brother

indicators.note: the reversed word takes the a inside it, so welcoming signals insertion
a mirror image reads backwards, so reflected signals reversal

parts.note: use means value or worth, as in of no use

explanation.surface: Valuing a mistreated sibling in a welcoming way.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis, Jacob cheated his twin of his birthright and blessing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible's Esau was tricked out of his inheritance by his brother Jacob.

clue.text: Turf war?

parts.note: a turf war is a gang dispute over territory, but read literally it is a fight on grass, a sports field

explanation.walkthrough: The pitch is a grass playing field, so a fight fought on turf is pitched.
explanation.definitionFit: A set-piece fight between drawn-up armies is a pitched battle, and pitch also means a playing field.
